prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [反例] 交错跨列 · 共享中间列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Merged cells: "与业务方共同梳理核心流程，输出需求说明书并完成评" spans 2 col × 1 row; "完成核心模块开发与联调，接入统一认证与日志平台" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 35px
  col 2: header "阶段一" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "阶段二" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "阶段三" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 199px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 198px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按需求、开发和测试项目展示三个阶段的工作安排。","reading":"先按行识别工作项目，再横向阅读各阶段；跨列说明代表相邻阶段共同承担的工作。长说明决定部分行高，较短内容的换行可利用这些行已有的高度。","groups":["阶段一、阶段二、阶段三是并列的时间阶段，应便于横向比较。","阶段二同时参与两段交错的跨列说明，其宽度会影响两段文本的换行。"],"keep_intact":["尽量让“项目”“需求”“开发”“测试”保持一行。","尽量让“用例”和“回归”保持一行，便于扫描。","阶段表头尽量按相近节奏换行，避免逐字竖排。"],"may_wrap":["两段跨列长说明可自然换行，但应保持连续的文本块。","“搭建脚手架”可分行，尽量避免逐字换行。","阶段表头可换行，优先保持“阶段”作为一个词。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [40, 51, 55, 52] · table 199×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [55, 48, 48, 47] · table 199×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [55, 43, 55, 45] · table 199×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"阶段二较宽，表头和“回归”更容易横向辨认；两段跨列说明保持为连续文本块。","problems":"项目名称逐字竖排，难以快速定位行；“搭建脚手架”和“用例”也呈窄竖列，破坏行内的阅读节奏。","cause":"项目列40px、阶段一51px，扣除边框和内边距后都不足以容纳两个完整汉字。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"三个阶段宽度接近，表头的换行节奏一致；交错跨列的两段说明宽度也较均衡。","problems":"项目名称仍逐字换行；阶段一的短内容和阶段二的“回归”也被拆开，整表形成多条竖排文字，横向比较吃力。","cause":"项目列55px比两字的一行需求少1px；三个阶段列只有47–48px，均不足以容纳两个完整汉字。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"阶段二获得较多空间，两段跨列说明都能受益；阶段列之间有一定的宽度区分。","problems":"项目名称仍竖排，阶段一更窄使“搭建脚手架”和“用例”难以扫描；相比r1B，行高没有改善。","cause":"项目列55px仍比两字的一行需求少1px；阶段一只有43px，而阶段二增加的宽度不足以改变跨列说明的行高。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"项目与阶段一优先","widths":[56,55,49,38],"change":"让项目名称完整一行，并加宽含“搭建脚手架”和“用例”的阶段一；压缩阶段三，观察表头和短内容的换行代价。"},{"name":"项目与中间列优先","widths":[56,38,55,49],"change":"让项目名称完整一行，重点照顾参与两段跨列说明的阶段二；观察较窄的阶段一是否值得其余部分获得的空间。"},{"name":"阶段均衡优先","widths":[38,55,55,50],"change":"保留项目名称竖排，将空间集中给三个并列阶段，尤其是共享的阶段二；检验更宽的工作内容区能否改善整体阅读。"}]}
